summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_037 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, emits a fully structured system abstraction surface with explicit evidence states per dimension, preserves the distinction between observed facts, conditional hypotheses and archetypal priors, and degrades non-modelable targets instead of inventing structural truth.

findings: The implementation accepts the declared upstream structural inputs from target definition, canonical screening context, observed field register, dataset coverage, source register and motor_039 archetype surfaces, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before delegation.
The adapter emits the contractually expected outputs: system_abstraction, system_abstraction_fields and system_abstraction_evidence_states.

Executable coverage confirms the documented core behaviors for building and manufacturing cases, including observed regulatory exposure where public coverage supports it and conditional or archetypal states where direct evidence is not yet available.
The implementation stays within boundary: it does not emit dominant-variable rankings, peers, benchmarks, redesigns or executive claims.
Each system_abstraction statement carries the expected governed fields: statement, evidence_state, supporting_sources, falsification_condition and minimum_evidence_required.
The bundle consistently covers the full structural dimension set and projects it into a synchronized system_abstraction_evidence_states surface.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check for One Vanderbilt reproduced the expected evidence-state pattern: asset_type and regulatory_exposure as OBSERVED_FACT, business_function as ARCHETYPAL_PRIOR and control_structure as CONDITIONAL_HYPOTHESIS.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered the direct building and manufacturing abstraction paths in the structural-intelligence system lane. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises the core statement bundle, evidence-state ladder and inadmissibility discipline described in test_spec.md and failure_modes_spec.md.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_structural_intelligence_system_lane.py -k motor_037 with 2 passing tests. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the One Vanderbilt case shape and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface without local logic drift.
